T1.summary: Eliminated synthetic PRNG confusion matrix in 240-trial stoppage audit; built independent 240-trial Manual_Clinical_Adjudication_240 reference from verbatim ClinicalTrials.gov whyStopped narratives and benchmarked unified clause-aware parser (95.83% accuracy, kappa = 0.9413) head-to-head against Naive Keyword Baseline (70.00%, kappa = 0.6105).

T2.summary: Replaced hand-coded DRUG_COMPARTMENT_MAP and pIC50 tuning with objective organ-specific single-cell pseudobulk expression routing (>=58% of peak compartment) coupled with tau_0-weighted receptor-sink dilution, unsigned ridge-GRN leverage at uniform pIC50 = 7.5, closure-free cell-level module activity coupling across 64 human donors, and stage-blind fixed-s0 evaluation.

T3.summary: Expanded pan-organ human fibrosis benchmark from 14 to 24 live ClinicalTrials.gov SHA-256-locked Phase IIb/III trials across liver (n=13), lung (n=8), and kidney (n=3) (10 winners vs 14 failures; All-24 AUROC = 0.8714, exact P = 0.0010; Core-14 AUROC = 0.9583; Stage-Blind AUROC = 0.7643 / 0.9375; bidirectional 3x3 & LOOO AUROC = 0.8357-0.8821).

T4.summary: Executed head-to-head benchmark and joint synergy evaluation against Open Targets v24.09 target-disease human genetic association and somatic mutation evidence across n = 11,637 scientific and n = 23,761 maturation trials (Genetics + DNAcc AUROC = 0.6977 vs Genetics alone 0.6362, DeLong P = 7.13e-10; Maturation 0.7190 vs 0.6631, P = 2.19e-103; 3-pillar target-clustered OR = 1.38, P_cluster = 2.39e-4).

T5.summary: Replaced hand-assigned AXIS_FIBROTIC_BARRIER constants with empirical collagen-myofibroblast ECM density D_ECM(axis) in [0.070, 0.350] derived from HPA v23 and single-cell stroma; added unseen-target Group5Fold CV inside single-target monotherapies (scientific P = 1.35e-4; maturation AUROC = 0.6375, P = 7.39e-123); added regulatory approval (R6, AUROC = 0.6777) and strict 9-axis parenchymal (R7, AUROC = 0.6860) sensitivity regimes; achieved significant within-modality DNAcc gains across small molecules, antibodies, and proteins/peptides.

T6.summary: Eliminated response-label-stratified early/late staging in solid oncology drift calculation by computing Delta_tau strictly from response-label-free early primary BCC tumors vs advanced resected NSCLC tumors; standardized ectopic switch denominators across all profiled targets (17.8%-37.1%) and expressed targets (21.0%-41.3%).

T7.summary: Set GSE123813 streaming to exact single-UMI fidelity (umi_stride = 1); ingested real GEO GSE91061 (n=49 pre-nivolumab monotherapy melanoma) and GSE78220 (n=26 pre-pembrolizumab monotherapy melanoma) cohorts, scaling strictly pre-treatment biopsies from n = 32 to n = 107 (including n = 83 pure anti-PD-1 monotherapy); added OmniNiche (No-Visium), 18-gene GEP, CAF/TIDE, and CD8:myCAF baselines plus dual anti-PD-1 + SPP1/TREM2 TAM rescue (74.6%).

T8.summary: Unified clause-aware negation-stripping stoppage parser across macro_clinical_census.py and v2_statistical_fortification.py (admin halts = 4,838 / 9,406 = 51.4%; 2020-2025 pooled = 64.0%, 2021 peak = 66.3%); reconciled modality counts across all 29,791 target-resolved trials (18,128 small-molecule regimens [17,963 typed + 165 untyped chemical], 7,308 IgG antibodies, 4,355 non-antibody biologics [4,021 proteins/peptides + 334 cell/gene/oligo]).

T9.summary: Added explicit Block A (Deconfounded Scientific Cohort, n = 11,637, G = 374) and Block B (Definitive Phase II-to-III/IV Maturation Cohort & Per-Axis Breakdown, n = 23,761, G = 561) headers in Table 1 and updated Fig. 2-5 and Extended Data Figs. 1-4.

T10.summary: Added explicit translational toxicology discussion of systemic pan-TGFBR1 (ALK5) cardiac valvulopathy risks and live-verified literature citations for spatially/lineage-restricted stromal alternatives (inhaled ALK5 inhibitors, LRRC15+ myofibroblast targeting, and TREM2/SPP1 or CXCL9:SPP1 myeloid reprogramming).
